# Tsubomi game fixes
#
# Recommended settings per game. The app downloads this file when it starts and applies a game's
# line when the game starts, unless the player has given that game settings of their own.
# Edit it on GitHub: the change is picked up the next time the app starts, no new build needed.
#
# One line per game:   TITLE_ID  setting=value  setting=value  | note
#
# Settings: memory-mapping, native-buffer, surface-sync, high-accuracy, async-shaders, texture-cache,
#           shader-cache, fps-hack, cpu-opt, v-sync, stretch (on/off), resolution (0.5 to 4),
#           screen-filter (Nearest, Bilinear, Bicubic, FXAA)
# Lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# Starting entries are from Vita3KiOS (oledz-i/Vita3KiOS, GPL-2.0-or-later); they were tested on an
# iPhone 16 Pro, so tell us if one does not help on your device.

# Gravity Rush (US, EU): without surface sync the bloom builds up and scenes are far too bright
PCSA00011 surface-sync=on | Surface sync on: fixes the over-bright bloom
PCSF00024 surface-sync=on | Surface sync on: fixes the over-bright bloom

# Persona 4 Golden (US, EU): vertex spikes in 3D scenes with GPU memory mapping
PCSE00120 memory-mapping=off | GPU memory mapping off: removes the spikes in 3D scenes
PCSB00245 memory-mapping=off | GPU memory mapping off: removes the spikes in 3D scenes

# Madden NFL 13
PCSE00084 memory-mapping=on native-buffer=on surface-sync=on high-accuracy=off async-shaders=on cpu-opt=on | Native buffer with surface sync; background shaders; high accuracy off

# Killzone Mercenary: same game ran at ~40 FPS with these settings and ~19 FPS with page-table mapping,
# high accuracy and surface sync on (owner's logs)
PCSA00107 memory-mapping=on native-buffer=off surface-sync=off high-accuracy=off fps-hack=on cpu-opt=on | Double-buffer memory mapping with surface sync and high accuracy off: about twice the frame rate in testing
